traditional: 鍾意 A 多過 B
jyutping: zung1 ji3 A do1 gwo3 B

english.note: Use this when you want to state the two alternatives explicitly and say that you like A more than B.

examples.english: I prefer iced lemon tea to hot milk tea.
examples.traditional: 我鍾意凍檸茶多過熱奶茶。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 dung3 ling4 caa4 do1 gwo3 jit6 naai5 caa4
